title: Echoes of Humanity - MoU
description: Adds a mysterious white dimension filled with ash, fog, craters, trenches, ruined machines, and echoes of a fallen humanity.
body:
# Echoes of Humanity

Echoes of Humanity is an atmospheric dimension mod for Minecraft that introduces a vast white wasteland covered in ash, fog, craters, trenches, and the remnants of a forgotten world.

This project was originally created as a foundation for a future modpack and larger story-driven experience. The long-term vision includes custom structures, environmental storytelling, lore, ambient music, visual effects, and many additional world-building features. However, that larger project does not yet exist publicly.

At the moment, Echoes of Humanity is intentionally simple. It focuses on atmosphere, exploration, and providing a unique environment that players, modpack creators, and developers can use however they wish.

Current features:

* A custom dimension.
* White fog and ash-filled atmosphere.
* Large open wastelands.
* Craters of various sizes.
* Sparse terrain with gentle elevation changes.
* Surface-focused world generation.
* A unique visual style inspired by themes of loss, memory, and the passage of civilizations.

This mod is currently considered a foundation for future development rather than a finished content-rich experience.

Feel free to:

* Use it in modpacks.
* Build adventures inside the dimension.
* Create your own lore around it.
* Modify and expand the code for personal projects.
* Use it as a starting point for your own dimension projects.


## Language Support

The mod currently includes translations for:

* de_de (German)
* en_us (English)
* es_es (Spanish)
* fr_fr (French)
* ja_jp (Japanese)
* ko_kr (Korean)
* pt_br (Brazilian Portuguese)
* ru_ru (Russian)
* uk_ua (Ukrainian)
* zh_cn (Simplified Chinese)

Thank you for checking.
